module: Controller of the editor's "Easy Select" tool (M.id = "ezObjectSelect", label "Easy Select"). Replaces classic object selection: discovery of objects under the mouse within a screen radius, stack of overlapping candidates, filters by distance/volume/name pattern, selection, moving (drag with projection onto terrain/raycast/screen, grid and rotation snap, placement on surface), modal operators G/R/S (transformOperator, rotateOperator, scaleOperator), native gizmo, "fence" mode (area selection sub-tool), camera bookmarks, orthographic camera and numpad presets. It centralizes the configuration (cfg), the state (st), the ezObjectSelect.* preferences and the workspace window (Selection, Hints, Fence tabs). It is driven by the module editor/ezObjectSelect.lua (edit mode) which calls activate/deactivate/update/drawWorkspace.
notes: activate() reserves selectability (selectabilityPresets.beginScope "staticsAndProps"); if it fails, returns false and the parent extension returns to the objectSelect mode.
The request*Shortcut shortcuts (G/R/S) do nothing as long as the suppressCameraForGrs preference is disabled (default false): in that case, S remains camera movement.
requestNumpadPreset is only taken into account if numpadMode == 1 (numpadMode preference).

Notable default preferences: discoveryRadius 100 px, maxDiscoveryOutlines 5, maxStackOutlines 5, maxPickDistance 150 m, maxStackDistance 200 m, maxPickVolume 500000 (box volume), selectionGizmoLengthScale 2, selectionGizmoLineWidth 4.

The prefUi functions are the custom renderers of the preferences (checkbox, slider, list); they ignore their first two parameters (cat, subCat), use item.path to call editor.setPreference and draw a "default value" button.

activate.desc: Activates the tool: resets the state, reserves selectability, enables the editor's temporary camera, applies the selection tint and the bindings.

returns.desc: true if active (already active or activation succeeded), false if the selectability reservation fails

deactivate.desc: Deactivates the tool: cancels fence, modal operators, transform session and native gizmo, restores the selection tint according to gizmos.general.highlightSelectedMeshes, gives back the camera and the numpad, leaves ortho.

isActive.desc: Indicates whether the tool is active.

update.desc: Per-frame update called by the edit mode: handles fence, modal operators, shortcuts, hover/selection, drag, native gizmo, camera and 3D drawing.

returns.desc: false if the tool is inactive; otherwise indicates that the tool handled the frame (value compared to true by the edit mode)

drawWorkspace.desc: Draws the content of the "Easy Select" window (Selection tab with snapping/placement/grid/rotation, Hints, Fence; camera bookmarks).

drawScreenDebug.desc: Draws the labels and diagnostics as a screen overlay (hover ring, labels, drag states). Does nothing if the tool is inactive or if fence is active.

invalidateSelectionCache.desc: Invalidates the selection model cache and the cached stats volume, and clears the last snapshot.

reason.desc: Reason (e.g. objectAdded, prefabExploded), passed to the cache

refreshSelectedTint.desc: Requests re-applying the tint of the selected meshes (setAxisGizmoHighlightSelectedMeshes) if the tool is active.

loadPreferences.desc: Loads all the editor's ezObjectSelect.* preferences into the local configuration.

resetInputFilters.desc: Unblocks wheel, camera movement, modal inputs and numpad, removes the action maps (Blender, numpad) and clears the shortcut requests.

onAxisGizmoModeChanged.desc: Hook relayed when the axis gizmo mode changes. During a native drag, restores the current mode; if the new mode is translate/rotate/scale, toggles the visibility of the native gizmo (the same mode a second time hides it).

onAxisGizmoAlignmentChanged.desc: Hook relayed when the gizmo alignment (world/local) changes: synchronizes the coordinate mode and passes the space to the active modal operators.

requestTransformShortcut.desc: Requests the move operator (G) if suppressCameraForGrs is enabled and no operation is in progress and objects are selected.

requestRotateShortcut.desc: Requests the rotate operator (R) under the same conditions.

requestScaleShortcut.desc: Requests the scale operator (S) under the same conditions.

requestFocusShortcut.desc: Smoothly centers the camera on the hovered object, otherwise on the selection (editor.fitViewToSelectionSmooth). Ignored during an operation.

requestNumpadPreset.desc: Stores a numpad view preset, applied on the next update if numpadMode == 1.

onEditorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook: copies the modified value of an ezObjectSelect.* preference into the local configuration.

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Registers the "ezObjectSelect" category (subcategories general, selection, etc.) with default values, bounds and prefUi renderers.

prefUi.desc: Local table of preference rendering functions in the editor's preferences window. Each function has the signature (cat, subCat, item): cat and subCat are ignored, item.path is the preference path. Each function draws the widget of the matching value and a reset-to-default button.

showHoverRing.desc: Checkbox: hover ring and guide lines.

discoveryRadius.desc: Integer: screen radius for object discovery (8 to 500 px, default 100).

maxDiscoveryOutlines.desc: Integer: max number of nearby object outlines (0 to 50, default 5).

maxStackOutlines.desc: Integer: max number of overlapping candidate outlines (1 to 50, default 5).

maxPickDistance.desc: Float: max distance between the camera focus point and a selectable object (10 to 500, default 150).

showVolumeFilteredObjects.desc: Checkbox: red outline of objects excluded by the volume limit.

maxPickVolume.desc: Float: max oriented box volume to be selectable (default 500000).

maxStackDistance.desc: Float: beyond this camera distance, hover only resolves the best object (10 to 1000, default 200).

outlineMode.desc: List: outline mode (Outline or filled boxes).

boundsDepthTest.desc: Checkbox: hide the hover box segments behind geometry.

selectedBoundsDepthTest.desc: Checkbox: same for the boxes of selected objects.

dragBoundsDepthTest.desc: Checkbox: same for the boxes during drag.

showMoveConstraintPlane.desc: Checkbox: draw the move plane (free or planar G).

clipMoveConstraintPlane.desc: Checkbox: hide the grid lines behind geometry (disabled if the plane is not displayed).

selectionGizmoLengthScale.desc: Float: length multiplier of the origin axes of selected objects (default 2).

showOrientationGizmo.desc: Checkbox: fixed world/local orientation indicator in the viewport.

orientationGizmoTopOffset.desc: Integer: vertical offset in pixels from the top-right corner (default 140).

orientationGizmoRightOffset.desc: Integer: horizontal offset in pixels from the top-right corner (default 75).

suppressCameraForGrs.desc: Checkbox: reserve G, R, S for the Move/Rotate/Scale modal tools (removes WASD camera movement).

numpadMode.desc: List: numpad mode (standard or view presets).
